message.content:
Create a second corpus of realistic, hand-written-looking test documents for exercising a YAML + Markdown formatter. Write files ONLY under /tmp/corpus2/ (create it). Do not read or modify anything under /workspace or /tmp/corpus. Do not run any formatter. Just write input files with plain UTF-8, LF line endings. Layout and counts: - /tmp/corpus2/yaml/ : 40 files (.yaml/.yml). Make them DIFFERENT from typical minimal examples: long real-world-sized files (80-300 lines) of these kinds: GitHub Actions workflows (multiple jobs, matrix include/exclude, services, `env:` with `${{ secrets.X }}`, `if:` expressions, multi-line `run: |` scripts, composite actions with `inputs:`/`outputs:`), docker-compose (anchors, `<<: *defaults`, healthchecks, deploy.resources, long command arrays), Kubernetes multi-document manifests (Deployment+Service+Ingress+ConfigMap+HPA+CronJob, annotations with long strings, `|` configs), Helm values.yaml (deep nesting, comments explaining every option, commented-out blocks, empty maps `{}`, lists `[]`), Ansible (playbooks, roles' tasks/main.yml, handlers, vars with Jinja `{{ }}` and `{% %}`, `when:` lists, `block:`/`rescue:`), OpenAPI 3 (large: many paths, parameters, schemas with `allOf`/`oneOf`, `example:` blocks, long `description:` with markdown, `enum: [a, b]`), mkdocs.yml with nav and plugins, GitLab CI with `extends:` and `!reference [..]` tags, CircleCI orbs, Netlify/Vercel style configs, Rust/Python project CI matrices, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, conda env with pip subsections, Spring `application.yml`, Prometheus rules with multi-line `expr: |`, Dependabot with groups. Messiness to include (varied per file): inconsistent indentation (2/3/4 spaces), sequences both indented and not under keys, extra spaces after colons and dashes (`key: value`, `- item`), trailing spaces, quoted strings that don't need quotes ('single' and "double"), unquoted strings that look like numbers/booleans (`version: 1.10`, `enabled: yes`, `TRUE`), `~` and `null`, long plain strings (>100 chars) and long quoted strings, comments in every position (top, between keys, trailing after values, indented differently than the content, inside sequences), blank lines (sometimes 2-3 in a row), document markers `---` and `...`, flow collections with odd spacing `{ a: 1,b: 2 }` `[ x,y ]`, empty values, multi-line flow collections, block scalars `|`, `|-`, `>`, `>-`, `|+`. Keep files valid YAML 1.2. - /tmp/corpus2/md/ : 40 files: 28 .md, 7 .qmd, 5 .Rmd. Long realistic files (80-300 lines): project READMEs with badges (`[![x](img)](link)` several on one line and on separate lines), install instructions with code fences in numbered lists, nested bullet lists (2-3 levels, with 2- and 4-space indents), task lists, tables (pipe tables with alignment colons, unaligned, wide cells, inline code in cells), blockquotes (multi-paragraph, nested, with lists inside), HTML blocks (`
`, `

`, ``), headings with trailing `#`, setext headings, emphasis with `_`/`__`/`*`/`**`, long paragraphs hard-wrapped at ~60-100 columns with ragged lines, very long single-line paragraphs, inline links with long URLs, reference links with definitions at the bottom, footnotes `[^1]`, horizontal rules `***` `___` `- - -`, CHANGELOGs (Keep a Changelog with many versions, nested bullets, links), CONTRIBUTING guides (numbered steps with sub-bullets and code fences), docs pages with admonitions (`!!! note` mkdocs style and GitHub `> [!NOTE]`), API docs with definition-like lists. Quarto .qmd: front matter (format options, bibliography, execute), code chunks ```{r} / ```{python} with `#|` options, callouts `::: {.callout-tip}`, `::: {.panel-tabset}` with `##` headings inside, figure divs, citations `[@a; @b]`, cross-refs, inline math `$x$`, display math `$$`. R Markdown .Rmd: `output:` options, chunks with `{r name, echo=FALSE}`, inline `` `r expr` ``, some with front matter `editor_options:\n markdown:\n wrap: sentence` (and some `wrap: 72` or `wrap: none`), long multi-sentence paragraphs with abbreviations (e.g., i.e., Dr., Fig., et al.), numbered and bulleted lists. tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final message is returned to you as the tool result; it is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- A previously spawned agent cannot be continued from here; every Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final message is returned to you as the tool result; it is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- A previously spawned agent cannot be continued from here; every Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).

If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). ---
# roles/nginx/tasks/main.yml
#
# Installs + configures nginx (distro package OR source build), drops the vhosts,
# hardens a couple of defaults and makes sure the thing actually answers on :80.
#
# Owner: web-platform (ping #ops-web before touching the vhost logic, it is load-bearing)
# NOTE: handlers live in ../handlers/main.yml -- "reload nginx" runs `nginx -t` first.


- name: Include OS-specific variables
  include_vars: "{{ item }}"
  with_first_found:
    - "{{ ansible_distribution | lower }}-{{ ansible_distribution_major_version }}.yml"
    - "{{ ansible_os_family | lower }}.yml"
    - default.yml
  tags: [ nginx,config ]

- name: Include OS-specific install tasks (RedHat / Suse live in their own files)
  include_tasks: "{{ ansible_os_family | lower }}.yml"
  when: not nginx_install_from_source | bool
  tags:
  - nginx
  - packages


- name:    Install nginx and helper packages
  ansible.builtin.package:
     name: "{{ item }}"
     state: present
  loop:
     - nginx
     - "{{ 'python3-passlib' if nginx_basic_auth_users | length > 0 else 'python3' }}"
     - logrotate
     # ssl-cert gives us the snakeoil pair for the catch-all vhost
     - ssl-cert
  when:
    - not nginx_install_from_source | bool
    - ansible_os_family == 'Debian'
  register: nginx_pkg_result
  until: nginx_pkg_result is succeeded
  retries: 3
  delay: 10
  tags: [ nginx, packages ]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Source build -- only the edge boxes need brotli + headers-more.
# FIXME(jk): move this into its own role, it is getting out of hand
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
- name: Build nginx from source
  when:
    - nginx_install_from_source | bool
    - ansible_distribution_major_version is version('20', '>=')
  tags: ['nginx', "source-build"]
  block:
    -   name: Install build dependencies
        apt:
          name: "{{ nginx_build_deps }}"
          state: present
          update_cache: yes
          cache_valid_time: 3600

    -   name: Download nginx {{ nginx_source_version }} tarball
        get_url:
          url: "https://nginx.org/download/nginx-{{ nginx_source_version }}.tar.gz"
          dest: /usr/local/src/nginx-{{ nginx_source_version }}.tar.gz
          checksum: "sha256:{{ nginx_source_sha256 }}"
          mode: 0644

    -   name: Unpack source
        unarchive:
          src: /usr/local/src/nginx-{{ nginx_source_version }}.tar.gz
          dest: /usr/local/src/
          remote_src: yes
          creates: /usr/local/src/nginx-{{ nginx_source_version }}/configure

    -   name: Configure and compile (takes ~6 min on the t3.small boxes, be patient)
        shell: >-
          ./configure --prefix=/etc/nginx --sbin-path=/usr/sbin/nginx
          --modules-path=/usr/lib/nginx/modules --conf-path=/etc/nginx/nginx.conf
          --with-http_ssl_module --with-http_v2_module --with-http_realip_module
          {% for mod in nginx_extra_modules %}--add-dynamic-module=/usr/local/src/{{ mod }} {% endfor %}
          && make -j{{ ansible_processor_vcpus | default(2) }}
          && make install
        args:
          chdir: /usr/local/src/nginx-{{ nginx_source_version }}
          creates: /usr/sbin/nginx

  rescue:
    - name: Source build failed - grab the tail of autoconf.err
      command: tail -n 50 /usr/local/src/nginx-{{ nginx_source_version }}/objs/autoconf.err
      register: nginx_autoconf_err
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Fail loudly
      fail:
        msg: "nginx source build failed on {{ inventory_hostname }}: {{ nginx_autoconf_err.stdout_lines | default([]) | join(' / ') }}"

  always:
  - name: Clean up the build tree
    file:
      path: /usr/local/src/nginx-{{ nginx_source_version }}
      state: absent
    when: nginx_cleanup_build_dir | default(true)


- name: Ensure config directories exist
  file:
    path: "{{ item.path }}"
    state: directory
    owner: root
    group: "{{ item.group | default('root') }}"
    mode: "{{ item.mode | default('0755') }}"
  loop:
  - { path: /etc/nginx/conf.d }
  - { path: /etc/nginx/sites-available }
  - { path: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled }
  - { path: /etc/nginx/snippets }
  - { path: "{{ nginx_log_dir }}", group: adm, mode: '0750' }
  - {path: /var/cache/nginx,mode: "0700"}
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.path }}"

- name: Check whether somebody dropped a hand-edited nginx.conf.local
  stat:
    path: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf.local
  register: nginx_local_conf

- name: Render main nginx.conf
  template:
    src: nginx.conf.j2
    dest: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: 0644
    backup: yes
    validate: 'nginx -t -c %s'
  when: not nginx_local_conf.stat.exists   # hand-edited -> leave it alone (see #1182)
  notify: reload nginx
  tags: [ nginx,config ]

- name:   Hide nginx version in error pages and the Server header
  lineinfile:
    path: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
    regexp: '^#?\s*server_tokens'
    line: "    server_tokens off;"
    insertafter: '^http \{'
    state: present
  notify: reload nginx
      # ^ only really matters for the source build, the template already sets it

- name: Deploy vhost configs
  template:
    src: "{{ item.template | default('vhost.conf.j2') }}"
    dest: "/etc/nginx/sites-available/{{ item.server_name }}.conf"
    mode: '0644'
  loop: "{{ nginx_vhosts }}"
  loop_control: { label: "{{ item.server_name }}" }
  when: item.state | default('present') == 'present'
  notify: reload nginx
  tags:
    - nginx
    - vhosts

- name: Enable vhosts
  file:
    src: /etc/nginx/sites-available/{{ item.server_name }}.conf
    dest: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/{{ item.server_name }}.conf
    state: link
  loop: "{{ nginx_vhosts }}"
  loop_control: { label: "{{ item.server_name }}" }
  when:
  - item.enabled | default(true) | bool
  - item.state | default('present') == 'present'
  notify: reload nginx

- name: Remove distro default site
  file:
    path: "{{ item }}"
    state: absent
  with_items:
    - /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default
    - /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
  when: nginx_remove_default_vhost
  notify: reload nginx

- name: Write upstreams.conf
  copy:
    dest: /etc/nginx/conf.d/upstreams.conf
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0644"
    content: |
      # {{ ansible_managed }}
      # generated from nginx_upstreams -- do NOT edit on the box
      {% for up in nginx_upstreams %}
      upstream {{ up.name }} {
      {%   if up.strategy is defined %}
          {{ up.strategy }};
      {%   endif %}
      {%   for srv in up.servers %}
          server {{ srv }}{% if up.max_fails is defined %} max_fails={{ up.max_fails }}{% endif %};
      {%   endfor %}
          keepalive {{ up.keepalive | default(32) }};
      }

      {% endfor %}
  notify:
    - validate nginx config
    - reload nginx

- name: Create htpasswd files for the basic-auth protected vhosts
  community.general.htpasswd:
    path: /etc/nginx/.htpasswd-{{ item.0.name }}
    name: "{{ item.1.user }}"
    password: "{{ item.1.password }}"
    owner: root
    group: www-data
    mode: 0640
  loop: "{{ nginx_basic_auth_users | subelements('users') }}"
  loop_control:
     label: "{{ item.0.name }}/{{ item.1.user }}"
  no_log: TRUE

- name: Logrotate config
  template: src=logrotate.j2 dest=/etc/logrotate.d/nginx owner=root group=root mode=0644

- name: Open 80/443 in ufw
  ufw:
    rule: allow
    port: "{{ item }}"
    proto: tcp
    comment:
  loop: [ '80', '443' ]
  when: nginx_manage_firewall | default(false)

- name: Remind people about the manual cert step
  debug:
    msg: Certificates for the public vhosts are issued by cert-manager on the k8s ingress, NOT here; this role only installs snakeoil certs for the catch-all.
  when: nginx_show_cert_reminder | default(false)

- name: Make sure nginx is enabled and running
  service:
    name: nginx
    state: started
    enabled: yes

# Flush handlers here so the health check below hits the *new* config.
- meta: flush_handlers

- name: Sanity-check the rendered config
  assert:
    that: [
        "nginx_worker_connections | int >= 1024",
        "nginx_vhosts | length > 0",
        "nginx_client_max_body_size is match('^[0-9]+[kKmMgG]?$')"
      ]
    fail_msg: "nginx_worker_connections too low or no vhosts defined for {{ inventory_hostname }} - check group_vars/web.yml"
    success_msg: All good
    quiet: true

- name: Health check - catch-all vhost answers
  uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ nginx_listen_port | default(80) }}/nginx-health"
    status_code: [200, 204]
    return_content: no
  register: nginx_health
  until: nginx_health.status in [200, 204]
  retries: 5
  delay: 3
  changed_when: false
  tags: [ nginx , healthcheck ]

---
# group_vars/all.yml
#
# Variables that apply to EVERY host in the acme-prod inventory.
# Host/group specific overrides go in group_vars/<group>.yml or host_vars/<host>.yml.
#
# Secrets are inline-vaulted (ansible-vault encrypt_string --vault-id prod@prompt).
# Rekey:  ansible-vault rekey --vault-id prod@prompt --new-vault-id prod@prompt group_vars/all.yml
#
# Last big cleanup: 2024-02 (jk) -- dropped the CentOS 7 leftovers.


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- app ---
app_name:     acme
app_version:  1.10        # FIXME: YAML reads this as the float 1.1 -> artifact URL 404s. Quote it!! (see #2210)
app_build: "1.10.4+build.317"
app_user: "{{ app_name }}"
app_group:    "{{ app_name }}"
app_home: "/opt/{{ app_name }}"
app_port: 8080
app_admin_port:   8081
app_env: production
app_debug: no
app_log_level: "info"
app_max_open_files: 1e5          # TODO: check the template renders 100000 and not 100000.0
app_feature_mask: 0x1F
app_umask: 0027
backup_window: 02:30             # HH:MM local time, consumed by the backup role
app_description: Acme order management backend, deployed as a single fat jar behind nginx
  with a local postgres replica for the read-heavy reporting queries.
deploy_notify_message: "Deployed {{ app_name }} {{ app_build }} to {{ app_env }} by {{ lookup('env', 'USER') | default('ci', true) }} - details at https://ci.acme.example/job/acme-deploy/"

app_logs:
  - name: app
    path: "{{ app_home }}/logs/app.log"
    rotate: 14
  - name: access
    path: "{{ app_home }}/logs/access.log"
    rotate: 30
    compress: yes
  - name: gc
    path: "{{ app_home }}/logs/gc.log"
    rotate: 5
    size: 100M
    compress: off


# JVM. Heap = half the RAM but never above 8g (G1 pauses get ugly above that on our boxes)
java_home: /usr/lib/jvm/temurin-17-jdk-amd64
java_opts: >-
  -Xms512m
  -Xmx{{ [ (ansible_memtotal_mb * 0.5) | int, 8192 ] | min }}m
  -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200
  -Xlog:gc*:file={{ app_home }}/logs/gc.log:time,uptime:filecount=5,filesize=20m
  -Djava.security.egd=file:/dev/./urandom
  -Dspring.profiles.active={{ app_env }}

# ------------------------------------------------------------- users ---
admin_users:
    jkowalski:
        uid: 2001
        shell: /bin/zsh
        groups: [ sudo,adm, docker ]
        ssh_keys:
            - "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIHk2b1m3Jx0rRk3pWqYlq7Cq0yWmXo8k1JqD2y7vS3aB jk@laptop"
            - "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIM1e9fQ2z8kQwVf3mY0bS5aC9xTnL4pH7rJdW2eGk6uE jk@yubikey"
    mnguyen:
        uid: 2002
        shell: /bin/bash
        groups:
        - sudo

---
# roles/nginx/handlers/main.yml
#
# Handler ORDER matters: Ansible runs handlers in the order they are DEFINED in this
# file, not in the order they were notified. So keep it like this:
#   1. validate config         (fail the play before we reload a broken config)
#   2. reload systemd          (unit files changed)
#   3. restart / reload nginx  (+ php-fpm)
#   4. restart app, then wait for it
#
# Need a handler to fire mid-play? Put
#     - meta: flush_handlers
# in the tasks (tasks/main.yml does exactly that right before the health check).


- name: validate nginx config
  command: nginx -t
  changed_when: false
  listen: "validate web config"

- name: reload systemd
  ansible.builtin.systemd:
    daemon_reload: yes


# legacy k=v style -- the old site.yml playbooks still notify "restart nginx", leave it
- name: restart nginx
  service: name=nginx state=restarted
  listen: "restart web stack"

- name: reload nginx
  ansible.builtin.systemd:
      name: nginx
      state: reloaded
  when: nginx_service_enabled | default(true) | bool
  listen:
    - "reload web stack"
    - nginx config changed

-   name:  restart php-fpm
    service:
        name: "php{{ php_version }}-fpm"
        state: restarted
    when: php_enabled | default(false)
    listen: restart web stack

- name: restart postgresql
  service:
    name: postgresql
    state: restarted
  throttle: 1          # one node at a time, the replicas need to catch up
  # run_once: true     # NO. that only restarted the first host -- see INC-2291
  listen: [ "restart db" ,  postgres config changed ]

- name: reload postgresql
  become: yes
  become_user: postgres
  command: "pg_ctlcluster {{ postgresql_version }} main reload"
  changed_when: True

- name: restart app
  systemd:
    name: "{{ app_name }}"
    state: restarted
    daemon_reload: no
  listen:
  - restart app stack
  - "app config changed"

- name: wait for app
  wait_for:
    host: 127.0.0.1
    port: "{{ app_port }}"
    delay: 5
    timeout: 120
    state: started
    msg: "{{ app_name }} did not come back on port {{ app_port }} within 120s - check `journalctl -u {{ app_name }} -n 200`"
  listen: restart app stack



- name: restart rsyslog
  service: name=rsyslog state=restarted

- name: reload firewall
  command: ufw reload
  when: firewall_enabled | default(true)
  # changed_when: false   <- deliberately left out so it shows up in the recap

- name: restart node_exporter
  service:
    name: node_exporter
    state: restarted
  when:      # TODO(mn): node_exporter_enabled | bool once every host has the var

- name: clear nginx cache
  file:
    path: /var/cache/nginx/proxy_temp/
    state: absent
  notify: restart nginx   # handlers CAN notify other handlers (ansible >= 2.2)

- name: restart haproxy
  service: { name: haproxy, state: restarted }
  when: "'lb' in group_names"
  listen:   restart web stack

  # NOTE: there is intentionally no "restart docker" handler here. Restarting
  # dockerd on the web boxes kills the sidecars; do it by hand in a maintenance window.

---
# roles/nginx/tasks/main.yml
#
# Installs + configures nginx (distro package OR source build), drops the vhosts,
# hardens a couple of defaults and makes sure the thing actually answers on :80.
#
# Owner: web-platform (ping #ops-web before touching the vhost logic, it is load-bearing)
# NOTE: handlers live in ../handlers/main.yml -- "reload nginx" runs `nginx -t` first.


- name: Include OS-specific variables
  include_vars: "{{ item }}"
  with_first_found:
    - "{{ ansible_distribution | lower }}-{{ ansible_distribution_major_version }}.yml"
    - "{{ ansible_os_family | lower }}.yml"
    - default.yml
  tags: [ nginx,config ]

- name: Include OS-specific install tasks (RedHat / Suse live in their own files)
  include_tasks: "{{ ansible_os_family | lower }}.yml"
  when: not nginx_install_from_source | bool
  tags:
  - nginx
  - packages


- name:    Install nginx and helper packages
  ansible.builtin.package:
     name: "{{ item }}"
     state: present
  loop:
     - nginx
     - "{{ 'python3-passlib' if nginx_basic_auth_users | length > 0 else 'python3' }}"
     - logrotate
     # ssl-cert gives us the snakeoil pair for the catch-all vhost
     - ssl-cert
  when:
    - not nginx_install_from_source | bool
    - ansible_os_family == 'Debian'
  register: nginx_pkg_result
  until: nginx_pkg_result is succeeded
  retries: 3
  delay: 10
  tags: [ nginx, packages ]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Source build -- only the edge boxes need brotli + headers-more.
# FIXME(jk): move this into its own role, it is getting out of hand
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
- name: Build nginx from source
  when:
    - nginx_install_from_source | bool
    - ansible_distribution_major_version is version('20', '>=')
  tags: ['nginx', "source-build"]
  block:
    -   name: Install build dependencies
        apt:
          name: "{{ nginx_build_deps }}"
          state: present
          update_cache: yes
          cache_valid_time: 3600

    -   name: Download nginx {{ nginx_source_version }} tarball
        get_url:
          url: "https://nginx.org/download/nginx-{{ nginx_source_version }}.tar.gz"
          dest: /usr/local/src/nginx-{{ nginx_source_version }}.tar.gz
          checksum: "sha256:{{ nginx_source_sha256 }}"
          mode: 0644

    -   name: Unpack source
        unarchive:
          src: /usr/local/src/nginx-{{ nginx_source_version }}.tar.gz
          dest: /usr/local/src/
          remote_src: yes
          creates: /usr/local/src/nginx-{{ nginx_source_version }}/configure

    -   name: Configure and compile (takes ~6 min on the t3.small boxes, be patient)
        shell: >-
          ./configure --prefix=/etc/nginx --sbin-path=/usr/sbin/nginx
          --modules-path=/usr/lib/nginx/modules --conf-path=/etc/nginx/nginx.conf
          --with-http_ssl_module --with-http_v2_module --with-http_realip_module
          {% for mod in nginx_extra_modules %}--add-dynamic-module=/usr/local/src/{{ mod }} {% endfor %}
          && make -j{{ ansible_processor_vcpus | default(2) }}
          && make install
        args:
          chdir: /usr/local/src/nginx-{{ nginx_source_version }}
          creates: /usr/sbin/nginx

  rescue:
    - name: Source build failed - grab the tail of autoconf.err
      command: tail -n 50 /usr/local/src/nginx-{{ nginx_source_version }}/objs/autoconf.err
      register: nginx_autoconf_err
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Fail loudly
      fail:
        msg: "nginx source build failed on {{ inventory_hostname }}: {{ nginx_autoconf_err.stdout_lines | default([]) | join(' / ') }}"

  always:
  - name: Clean up the build tree
    file:
      path: /usr/local/src/nginx-{{ nginx_source_version }}
      state: absent
    when: nginx_cleanup_build_dir | default(true)


- name: Ensure config directories exist
  file:
    path: "{{ item.path }}"
    state: directory
    owner: root
    group: "{{ item.group | default('root') }}"
    mode: "{{ item.mode | default('0755') }}"
  loop:
  - { path: /etc/nginx/conf.d }
  - { path: /etc/nginx/sites-available }
  - { path: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled }
  - { path: /etc/nginx/snippets }
  - { path: "{{ nginx_log_dir }}", group: adm, mode: '0750' }
  - {path: /var/cache/nginx,mode: "0700"}
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.path }}"

- name: Check whether somebody dropped a hand-edited nginx.conf.local
  stat:
    path: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf.local
  register: nginx_local_conf

- name: Render main nginx.conf
  template:
    src: nginx.conf.j2
    dest: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: 0644
    backup: yes
    validate: 'nginx -t -c %s'
  when: not nginx_local_conf.stat.exists   # hand-edited -> leave it alone (see #1182)
  notify: reload nginx
  tags: [ nginx,config ]

- name:   Hide nginx version in error pages and the Server header
  lineinfile:
    path: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
    regexp: '^#?\s*server_tokens'
    line: "    server_tokens off;"
    insertafter: '^http \{'
    state: present
  notify: reload nginx
      # ^ only really matters for the source build, the template already sets it

- name: Deploy vhost configs
  template:
    src: "{{ item.template | default('vhost.conf.j2') }}"
    dest: "/etc/nginx/sites-available/{{ item.server_name }}.conf"
    mode: '0644'
  loop: "{{ nginx_vhosts }}"
  loop_control: { label: "{{ item.server_name }}" }
  when: item.state | default('present') == 'present'
  notify: reload nginx
  tags:
    - nginx
    - vhosts

- name: Enable vhosts
  file:
    src: /etc/nginx/sites-available/{{ item.server_name }}.conf
    dest: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/{{ item.server_name }}.conf
    state: link
  loop: "{{ nginx_vhosts }}"
  loop_control: { label: "{{ item.server_name }}" }
  when:
  - item.enabled | default(true) | bool
  - item.state | default('present') == 'present'
  notify: reload nginx

- name: Remove distro default site
  file:
    path: "{{ item }}"
    state: absent
  with_items:
    - /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default
    - /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
  when: nginx_remove_default_vhost
  notify: reload nginx

- name: Write upstreams.conf
  copy:
    dest: /etc/nginx/conf.d/upstreams.conf
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0644"
    content: |
      # {{ ansible_managed }}
      # generated from nginx_upstreams -- do NOT edit on the box
      {% for up in nginx_upstreams %}
      upstream {{ up.name }} {
      {%   if up.strategy is defined %}
          {{ up.strategy }};
      {%   endif %}
      {%   for srv in up.servers %}
          server {{ srv }}{% if up.max_fails is defined %} max_fails={{ up.max_fails }}{% endif %};
      {%   endfor %}
          keepalive {{ up.keepalive | default(32) }};
      }

      {% endfor %}
  notify:
    - validate nginx config
    - reload nginx

- name: Create htpasswd files for the basic-auth protected vhosts
  community.general.htpasswd:
    path: /etc/nginx/.htpasswd-{{ item.0.name }}
    name: "{{ item.1.user }}"
    password: "{{ item.1.password }}"
    owner: root
    group: www-data
    mode: 0640
  loop: "{{ nginx_basic_auth_users | subelements('users') }}"
  loop_control:
     label: "{{ item.0.name }}/{{ item.1.user }}"
  no_log: TRUE

- name: Logrotate config
  template: src=logrotate.j2 dest=/etc/logrotate.d/nginx owner=root group=root mode=0644

- name: Open 80/443 in ufw
  ufw:
    rule: allow
    port: "{{ item }}"
    proto: tcp
    comment:
  loop: [ '80', '443' ]
  when: nginx_manage_firewall | default(false)

- name: Remind people about the manual cert step
  debug:
    msg: Certificates for the public vhosts are issued by cert-manager on the k8s ingress, NOT here; this role only installs snakeoil certs for the catch-all.
  when: nginx_show_cert_reminder | default(false)

- name: Make sure nginx is enabled and running
  service:
    name: nginx
    state: started
    enabled: yes

# Flush handlers here so the health check below hits the *new* config.
- meta: flush_handlers

- name: Sanity-check the rendered config
  assert:
    that: [
        "nginx_worker_connections | int >= 1024",
        "nginx_vhosts | length > 0",
        "nginx_client_max_body_size is match('^[0-9]+[kKmMgG]?$')"
      ]
    fail_msg: "nginx_worker_connections too low or no vhosts defined for {{ inventory_hostname }} - check group_vars/web.yml"
    success_msg: All good
    quiet: true

- name: Health check - catch-all vhost answers
  uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ nginx_listen_port | default(80) }}/nginx-health"
    status_code: [200, 204]
    return_content: no
  register: nginx_health
  until: nginx_health.status in [200, 204]
  retries: 5
  delay: 3
  changed_when: false
  tags: [ nginx , healthcheck ]

# roles/nginx/handlers/main.yml
#
# Handler ORDER matters: Ansible runs handlers in the order they are DEFINED in this
# file, not in the order they were notified. So keep it like this:
#   1. validate config         (fail the play before we reload a broken config)
#   2. reload systemd          (unit files changed)
#   3. restart / reload nginx  (+ php-fpm)
#   4. restart app, then wait for it
#
# Need a handler to fire mid-play? Put
#     - meta: flush_handlers
# in the tasks (tasks/main.yml does exactly that right before the health check).


- name: validate nginx config
  command: nginx -t
  changed_when: false
  listen: "validate web config"

- name: reload systemd
  ansible.builtin.systemd:
    daemon_reload: yes


# legacy k=v style -- the old site.yml playbooks still notify "restart nginx", leave it
- name: restart nginx
  service: name=nginx state=restarted
  listen: "restart web stack"

- name: reload nginx
  ansible.builtin.systemd:
      name: nginx
      state: reloaded
  when: nginx_service_enabled | default(true) | bool
  listen:
    - "reload web stack"
    - nginx config changed

-   name:  restart php-fpm
    service:
        name: "php{{ php_version }}-fpm"
        state: restarted
    when: php_enabled | default(false)
    listen: restart web stack

- name: restart postgresql
  service:
    name: postgresql
    state: restarted
  throttle: 1          # one node at a time, the replicas need to catch up
  # run_once: true     # NO. that only restarted the first host -- see INC-2291
  listen: [ "restart db" ,  postgres config changed ]

- name: reload postgresql
  become: yes
  become_user: postgres
  command: "pg_ctlcluster {{ postgresql_version }} main reload"
  changed_when: True

- name: restart app
  systemd:
    name: "{{ app_name }}"
    state: restarted
    daemon_reload: no
  listen:
  - restart app stack
  - "app config changed"

- name: wait for app
  wait_for:
    host: 127.0.0.1
    port: "{{ app_port }}"
    delay: 5
    timeout: 120
    state: started
    msg: "{{ app_name }} did not come back on port {{ app_port }} within 120s - check `journalctl -u {{ app_name }} -n 200`"
  listen: restart app stack



- name: restart rsyslog
  service: name=rsyslog state=restarted

- name: reload firewall
  command: ufw reload
  when: firewall_enabled | default(true)
  # changed_when: false   <- deliberately left out so it shows up in the recap

- name: restart node_exporter
  service:
    name: node_exporter
    state: restarted
  when:      # TODO(mn): node_exporter_enabled | bool once every host has the var

- name: clear nginx cache
  file:
    path: /var/cache/nginx/proxy_temp/
    state: absent
  notify: restart nginx   # handlers CAN notify other handlers (ansible >= 2.2)

- name: restart haproxy
  service: { name: haproxy, state: restarted }
  when: "'lb' in group_names"
  listen:   restart web stack

  # NOTE: there is intentionally no "restart docker" handler here. Restarting
  # dockerd on the web boxes kills the sidecars; do it by hand in a maintenance window.

# Acme Petstore -- OpenAPI contract for the storefront + partner integrations.
# Rendered at https://developer.acme.example/petstore (redoc). Lint with `make lint-api`.
# TODO: move to 3.1 once the codegen supports it (#88)
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Acme Petstore API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: |
    # Acme Petstore

    This is the **extended** petstore used by the storefront and the partner
    integrations. It is *mostly* compatible with the classic Swagger petstore,
    with a few additions:

    - photo uploads (`multipart/form-data`)
    - order management under `/store/orders`
    - offset paging via `limit` + `offset` (yes, we know -- see [ADR-007](https://wiki.acme.example/adr/007-pagination))

    ## Authentication

    Read endpoints accept an `api_key` header. Anything that mutates state needs
    an OAuth2 token with the matching scope:

        curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.petstore.acme.example/v1/pets

    ## Rate limits
    1. 100 requests/minute per API key
    2. 1000 requests/minute per OAuth client
  termsOfService: https://petstore.acme.example/terms/
  contact:
    name:  Petstore API team
    email: "api-team@acme.example"
    url: https://acme.example/support
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: 'https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.html'

servers:
  - url: https://{environment}.petstore.acme.example/v1
    description: Production / staging (pick with the `environment` variable)
    variables:
      environment:
        default: api
        enum: [api, api.dev, api.staging]
  - url: http://localhost:8080/v1
    description: "Local dev (docker compose up)"

tags:
- name: pet
  description: Everything about your pets
  externalDocs:
    description: Find out more
    url: https://docs.acme.example/petstore/pets
- name: store
  description: Access to petstore orders
- name: user
  description:   Operations about user
  externalDocs: { description: "User guide", url: "https://docs.acme.example/petstore/users" }


paths:
  /pets:
    get:
      tags: [ pet ]
      summary: List pets
      description: Returns all pets the caller has access to, optionally filtered by tag. Results are ordered by createdAt, newest first.
      operationId: listPets
      parameters:
        - name: limit
          in: query
          description: How many items to return at one time (max 100)
          required: false
          schema: { type: integer, format: int32, minimum: 1, maximum: 100, default: 20 }
        - name: offset
          in: query
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
        - name: tags
          in: query
          description: tags to filter by
          required: false
          style: form
          explode: false
          schema:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
          example: [dog,cat]
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/RequestId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A paged array of pets
          headers:
            x-next:
              description: A link to the next page of responses
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Pets"
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnexpectedError'
    post:
      tags: [pet]
      summary: Create a pet
      operationId: createPet
      requestBody:
        $ref: '#/components/requestBodies/NewPet'
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Null response
        '422':
          $ref: "#/components/responses/ValidationError"
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnexpectedError'
      security:
        - petstore_auth: [ "write:pets", "read:pets" ]

  /pets/{petId}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/PetId'
    get:
      tags:
        - pet
      summary: Info for a specific pet
      operationId: showPetById
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Expected response to a valid request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AnyPet'
              example:
                id: 10
                name: Rex
                petType: dog
                status: available
                tags: [ good-boy, "vaccinated" ]
                packSize: 1
        '404':
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
    put:
      tags: [ pet ]
      summary: Replace a pet
      operationId: replacePet
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet' }
      responses:
        '200': { description: Updated }
        '404': { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
    delete:
      tags: [ pet ]
      summary: Deletes a pet
      operationId: deletePet
      parameters:
        - { name: api_key, in: header, required: false, schema: { type: string } }
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Deleted
        '400':
          description: Invalid pet value

  /pets/{petId}/photos:
    post:
      tags: [pet]
      summary: Upload a photo
      operationId: uploadPetPhoto
      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/PetId'
      requestBody:
        content:
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [file]
              properties:
                file:
                  type: string
                  format: binary
                caption: { type: string, maxLength: 280 }
            encoding:
              file:
                contentType: image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Photo stored
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Photo'
        '413':
          description: File too large (limit is 10 MB)

  /store/orders:
    post:
      tags:
      - store
      summary: Place an order for a pet
      operationId: placeOrder
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Order'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Order'
        '405':
          description: Invalid input
  /store/orders/{orderId}:
    get:
      tags: [ store ]
      operationId: getOrderById
      summary: Find purchase order by ID
      description: For valid response try integer IDs with value <= 5 or > 10. Other values will generate exceptions.
      parameters:
        - name: orderId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: {type: integer, format: int64}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Order' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }

  # copied over from the legacy spec, which used 4-space indents -- never got reformatted
  /users/login:
      get:
          tags: [user]
          summary: Logs user into the system
          operationId: loginUser
          parameters:
              - name: username
                in: query
                required: true
                schema: { type: string }
              - name: password
                in: query
                required: true
                schema: { type: string, format: password }
          responses:
              '200':
                  description: successful operation
                  headers:
                      X-Rate-Limit:
                          description: calls per hour allowed by the user
                          schema: { type: integer, format: int32 }
                      X-Expires-After:
                          description: date in UTC when token expires
                          schema:
                              type: string
                              format: date-time
                  content:
                      application/json:
                          schema:
                              type: string
              '400':
                  description: Invalid username/password supplied
          security: []

components:
  parameters:
    PetId:
      name: petId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: The id of the pet to retrieve
      schema:
        type: string
    RequestId: { name: X-Request-Id, in: header, required: false, schema: { type: string, format: uuid } }

  requestBodies:
    NewPet:
      description: Pet object that needs to be added to the store
      required: true
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/NewPet'

  responses:
    NotFound:
      description: The specified resource was not found
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
    ValidationError:
      description: Request body failed validation
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error' }
          example:
            code: 422
            message: "name: must not be blank"
    UnexpectedError:
      description: unexpected error
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"

  schemas:
    NewPet:
      type: object
      required:
        - name
        - petType
      properties:
        name: { type: string, example: Rex }
        petType:
          type: string
        status:
          type: string
          description: pet status in the store
          enum: [available, pending,sold]
          default: available
        tags:
          type: array
          items: { type: string }
    Pet:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/NewPet'
        - type: object
          required: [ id ]
          properties:
            id: { type: integer, format: int64, readOnly: true }
            createdAt:
              type: string
              format: date-time
    AnyPet:
      oneOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Dog'
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Cat'
        - $ref: "#/components/schemas/Lizard"
      discriminator:
        propertyName: petType
        mapping:
          dog: '#/components/schemas/Dog'
          cat: "#/components/schemas/Cat"
          lizard: '#/components/schemas/Lizard'
    Dog:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
      - type: object
        properties:
          packSize:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            description: the size of the pack the dog is from
            default: 0
            minimum: 0
    Cat:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
      - type: object
        properties:
          huntingSkill:
            type: string
            description: The measured skill for hunting
            enum: [ clueless, lazy, adventurous, aggressive ]
    Lizard:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        - type: object
          properties:
            lovesRocks: { type: boolean }
    Pets:
      type: array
      maxItems: 100
      items:
        $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
    Photo:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        url: { type: string, format: uri }
        caption: { type: string, nullable: true }
    Order:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: {type: integer, format: int64}
        petId: {type: integer, format: int64}
        quantity: {type: integer, format: int32, minimum: 1}
        shipDate:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        status:
          type: string
          description: Order Status
          enum:
            - placed
            - approved
            - delivered
        complete:
          type: boolean
          default: false
      example:
        id: 10
        petId: 198772
        quantity: 7
        shipDate: 2024-03-01T10:15:00Z
        status: approved
        complete: false
    Error:
      type: object
      required: [code, message]
      properties:
        code: { type: integer, format: int32 }
        message:
          type: string

  securitySchemes:
    api_key:
      type: apiKey
      name: api_key
      in: header
    petstore_auth:
      type: oauth2
      flows:
        implicit:
          authorizationUrl: https://auth.acme.example/oauth/authorize
          scopes:
            write:pets: modify pets in your account
            read:pets: read your pets
        clientCredentials:
          tokenUrl: https://auth.acme.example/oauth/token
          scopes:
            "write:pets": modify pets in your account
            'read:pets': read your pets
security:
  - api_key: []

# Acme Petstore -- OpenAPI contract for the storefront + partner integrations.
# Rendered at https://developer.acme.example/petstore (redoc). Lint with `make lint-api`.
# TODO: move to 3.1 once the codegen supports it (#88)
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Acme Petstore API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: |
    # Acme Petstore

    The **extended** petstore used by the storefront and partner integrations. It is
    *mostly* compatible with the classic Swagger petstore, plus:

    - photo uploads (`multipart/form-data`) and order management under `/store/orders`
    - offset paging via `limit` + `offset` (yes, we know -- see [ADR-007](https://wiki.acme.example/adr/007-pagination))

    ## Authentication
    Read endpoints accept an `api_key` header; anything that mutates state needs an
    OAuth2 token with the matching scope:

        curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.petstore.acme.example/v1/pets
  termsOfService: https://petstore.acme.example/terms/
  contact:
    name:  Petstore API team
    email: "api-team@acme.example"
    url: https://acme.example/support
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: 'https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.html'

servers:
  - url: https://{environment}.petstore.acme.example/v1
    description: Production / staging (pick with the `environment` variable)
    variables:
      environment:
        default: api
        enum: [api, api.dev, api.staging]
  - url: http://localhost:8080/v1
    description: "Local dev (docker compose up)"
tags:
- name: pet
  description: Everything about your pets
  externalDocs:
    description: Find out more
    url: https://docs.acme.example/petstore/pets
- name: store
  description: Access to petstore orders
- name: user
  description:   Operations about user
  externalDocs: { description: "User guide", url: "https://docs.acme.example/petstore/users" }


paths:
  /pets:
    get:
      tags: [ pet ]
      summary: List pets
      description: Returns all pets the caller has access to, optionally filtered by tag. Results are ordered by createdAt, newest first.
      operationId: listPets
      parameters:
        - name: limit
          in: query
          description: How many items to return at one time (max 100)
          required: false
          schema: { type: integer, format: int32, minimum: 1, maximum: 100, default: 20 }
        - name: tags
          in: query
          description: tags to filter by
          required: false
          style: form
          explode: false
          schema:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
          example: [dog,cat]
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/RequestId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A paged array of pets
          headers:
            x-next: { description: Link to the next page, schema: { type: string } }
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                maxItems: 100
                items:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/Pet"
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnexpectedError'
    post:
      tags: [pet]
      summary: Create a pet
      operationId: createPet
      requestBody:
        $ref: '#/components/requestBodies/NewPet'
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Null response
        '422':
          $ref: "#/components/responses/ValidationError"
      security:
        - petstore_auth: [ "write:pets", "read:pets" ]

  /pets/{petId}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/PetId'
    get:
      tags:
        - pet
      summary: Info for a specific pet
      operationId: showPetById
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Expected response to a valid request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AnyPet'
              example:
                id: 10
                name: Rex
                petType: dog
                tags: [ good-boy, "vaccinated" ]
                packSize: 1
        '404':
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
    put:
      tags: [ pet ]
      summary: Replace a pet
      operationId: replacePet
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet' } } }
      responses:
        '200': { description: Updated }
        '404': { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
    delete:
      tags: [ pet ]
      summary: Deletes a pet
      operationId: deletePet
      parameters:
        - { name: api_key, in: header, required: false, schema: { type: string } }
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Deleted

  /pets/{petId}/photos:
    post:
      tags: [pet]
      summary: Upload a photo
      operationId: uploadPetPhoto
      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/PetId'
      requestBody:
        content:
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [file]
              properties:
                file: { type: string, format: binary }
                caption: { type: string, maxLength: 280 }
            encoding:
              file: { contentType: "image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp" }
      responses:
        '201': { description: Photo stored }
        '413': { description: File too large (limit is 10 MB) }

  /store/orders:
    post:
      tags:
      - store
      summary: Place an order for a pet
      operationId: placeOrder
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Order'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Order' }
        '405': { description: Invalid input }

  # copied over from the legacy spec (4-space indents) -- never got reformatted
  /users/login:
      get:
          tags: [user]
          summary: Logs user into the system
          operationId: loginUser
          parameters:
              - { name: username, in: query, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
              - name: password
                in: query
                required: true
                schema: { type: string, format: password }
          responses:
              '200':
                  description: successful operation
                  headers:
                      X-Rate-Limit:
                          description: calls per hour allowed by the user
                          schema: { type: integer, format: int32 }
                  content:
                      application/json:
                          schema:
                              type: string
              '400':
                  description: Invalid username/password supplied
          security: []

components:
  parameters:
    PetId:
      name: petId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: The id of the pet to retrieve
      schema: { type: string }
    RequestId: { name: X-Request-Id, in: header, required: false, schema: { type: string, format: uuid } }
  requestBodies:
    NewPet:
      description: Pet object that needs to be added to the store
      required: true
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/NewPet'
  responses:
    NotFound:
      description: The specified resource was not found
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
    ValidationError:
      description: Request body failed validation
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error' }
          example:
            code: 422
            message: "name: must not be blank"
    UnexpectedError:
      description: unexpected error
      content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" } } }

  schemas:
    NewPet:
      type: object
      required:
        - name
        - petType
      properties:
        name: { type: string, example: Rex }
        petType: { type: string }
        status:
          type: string
          description: pet status in the store
          enum: [available, pending,sold]
          default: available
        tags: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
    Pet:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/NewPet'
        - type: object
          required: [ id ]
          properties:
            id: { type: integer, format: int64, readOnly: true }
            createdAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
    AnyPet:
      oneOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Dog'
        - $ref: "#/components/schemas/Cat"
      discriminator:
        propertyName: petType
        mapping:
          dog: '#/components/schemas/Dog'
          cat: "#/components/schemas/Cat"
    Dog:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
      - type: object
        properties:
          packSize: { type: integer, format: int32, minimum: 0, default: 0 }
    Cat:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
      - type: object
        properties:
          huntingSkill:
            type: string
            enum: [ clueless, lazy, adventurous, aggressive ]
    Order:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: {type: integer, format: int64}
        petId: {type: integer, format: int64}
        quantity: {type: integer, format: int32, minimum: 1}
        shipDate: { type: string, format: date-time }
        status:
          type: string
          enum:
            - placed
            - approved
            - delivered
        complete: { type: boolean, default: false }
      example:
        id: 10
        petId: 198772
        quantity: 7
        shipDate: 2024-03-01T10:15:00Z
        status: approved
    Error:
      type: object
      required: [code, message]
      properties:
        code: { type: integer, format: int32 }
        message: { type: string }

  securitySchemes:
    api_key:
      type: apiKey
      name: api_key
      in: header
    petstore_auth:
      type: oauth2
      flows:
        authorizationCode:
          authorizationUrl: https://auth.acme.example/oauth/authorize
          tokenUrl: https://auth.acme.example/oauth/token
          scopes:
            write:pets: modify pets in your account
            'read:pets': read your pets
security:
  - api_key: []

paths:
  /pets:
    get:

      summary: List pets
      description: Returns all pets the caller has access to, optionally filtered by tag. Results are ordered by createdAt, newest first.
      operationId: listPets
      parameters:
        - name: limit
          in: query
          description: How many items to return at one time (max 100)
          required: false
          schema: { type: integer, format: int32, minimum: 1, maximum: 100, default: 20 }
        - name: tags
          in: query
          description: tags to filter by
          style: form
          explode: false
          schema: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
          example: [dog,cat]
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A paged array of pets
          headers:
            x-next: { description: Link to the next page, schema: { type: string } }
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { type: array, maxItems: 100, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Pet" } }
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnexpectedError'
    post:
      tags: [pet]
      summary: Create a pet
      operationId: createPet
      requestBody:
        $ref: '#/components/requestBodies/NewPet'
      responses:
        "201": { description: Null response }
        '422':

                          schema: { type: integer, format: int32 }
                  content: { application/json: { schema: { type: string } } }
              '400':
                  description: Invalid username/password supplied
          security: []

  parameters:

      name: petId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema: { type: string }
  requestBodies:

      description: Pet object that needs to be added to the store

  responses:

      description: The specified resource was not found

# Acme Billing API -- public contract (OpenAPI 3.1).

# Lint:  npx @redocly/cli lint openapi-billing.yml

jsonSchemaDialect: https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.1/dialect/base
info:
  title: Acme Billing API
  version: '2024-05-01'
  summary: Customers, invoices and payment methods.
  description: >
    The Billing API lets you create customers, attach payment methods and
    issue invoices. All amounts are integers in the **smallest currency unit**
    (cents for EUR/USD, yen for JPY).


    Requests are authenticated with a secret key passed as a bearer token.
    Test-mode keys start with `sk_test_`, live keys with `sk_live_`.
  contact: { name: Billing team, email: billing-api@acme.example }
  license:
    name: Proprietary
    identifier: LicenseRef-Acme-Proprietary
servers:
- url: https://api.acme.example
  description: live
- url: https://sandbox.api.acme.example
  description: "sandbox (test keys only)"
security:
  - bearerAuth: []
tags:
  - { name: Customers }
  - { name: Invoices, description: "Invoices are immutable once finalized." }
  - name: PaymentMethods
    x-displayName: Payment methods

webhooks:
    invoicePaid:
        post:
            summary: Invoice paid
            description: >-
                Sent when an invoice transitions to `paid`. Delivery is at-least-once, so use the event `id` to
                deduplicate. Respond with any 2xx within 10 seconds or we retry with exponential backoff for up to 3 days.
            operationId: onInvoicePaid
            parameters:
                - name: Acme-Signature
                  in: header
                  required: true
                  description: "HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body using your endpoint secret, hex encoded. Format: t=<unix timestamp>,v1=<signature>"
                  schema: { type: string }
            requestBody:
                content:
                    application/json:
                        schema:
                            $ref: '#/components/schemas/InvoiceEvent'
            responses:
                '2XX':
                    description: Acknowledged


paths:
  /v1/customers:
    get:
      tags: [Customers]
      operationId: listCustomers
      summary: List customers
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Limit'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/StartingAfter'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/EndingBefore'
        - { name: email, in: query, description: "Exact, case-insensitive match.", schema: { type: string, format: email } }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A page of customers.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [data, has_more]
                properties:
                  object: { const: list }
                  data:
                    type: array
                    items: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Customer' }
                  has_more: { type: boolean }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
    post:
      tags: [ Customers ]
      operationId: createCustomer
      summary: Create a customer

          content:

        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/IdempotencyConflict'

        '400':

      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:

      responses:
        '201':
          description: Attached
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/PaymentMethod' }
        '402':
          description: The card was declined.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
              examples:
                card_declined:
                  summary: Generic decline
                  value: { error: { code: card_declined, message: "Your card was declined." } }

components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth: { type: http, scheme: bearer, bearerFormat: "sk_(test|live)_..." }
  parameters:
    Limit:
      name: limit
      in: query
      schema: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 100, default: 10 }
    StartingAfter:
      name: starting_after
      in: query
      description: A cursor for pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list; pass the ID of the last object of the previous page.
      schema:
        type: string
    EndingBefore:
      name: ending_before
      in: query
      description: Cursor for paginating backwards. Mutually exclusive with `starting_after`.
      schema: { type: string }
    IdempotencyKey:
      name: Idempotency-Key
      in: header
      required: false
      description: >-
        Any unique string (we recommend a V4 UUID). Retrying a request with the same key
        within 24 hours returns the original response instead of performing the operation twice.
      schema: { type: string, maxLength: 255 }
  responses:
    Unauthorized:
      description: Missing or invalid API key.
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error' }
    IdempotencyConflict:
      description: A request with the same Idempotency-Key but different parameters is in progress or already completed.
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  schemas:
    Money:
      type: object
      required: [ amount,currency ]
      properties:
        amount:
          type: integer
          description: Amount in the smallest currency unit.
          examples: [1999, 0, 120000]
        currency:
          type: string
          pattern: '^[A-Z]{3}$'
          examples: ["EUR", 'USD', JPY]
    Metadata:
      type: object
      maxProperties: 50
      additionalProperties: { type: [string, 'null'], maxLength: 500 }
    Customer:
      type: object
      required: [id, object, email, created]
      properties:
        id: { type: string, examples: [cus_Q2x8ZpLmN0aBcD] }
        object: { const: customer }
        email: { type: string, format: email }
        name: { type: [string, 'null'] }
        created: { type: integer, description: Unix timestamp (seconds). }
        metadata: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Metadata' }
        risk_score:
          type: number
          x-internal: TRUE
          example: null
    Invoice:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        object: { const: invoice }
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [draft, open, paid, uncollectible, void]
        number:
          type: [string, 'null']
          description: Assigned on finalization, e.g. ACME-2024-000123.
        total: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money' }
        due_date:
          type: [ integer, "null" ]
          default: ~
    InvoiceEvent:
      type: object
      required: [id, type, data]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        type: { const: invoice.paid }
        data: { type: object, properties: { object: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Invoice' } } }
    PaymentMethod:
      oneOf: [
          { $ref: '#/components/schemas/CardPaymentMethod' },
          # { $ref: '#/components/schemas/AchPaymentMethod' },   # US launch slipped to Q3
          { $ref: "#/components/schemas/SepaDebitPaymentMethod" }
        ]
      discriminator:
        propertyName: type
    CardPaymentMethod:
      type: object
      required: [type, card]
      properties:
        type: { const: card }
        card:
          type: object
          properties:
            token: { type: string, writeOnly: true }
            brand: { type: string, readOnly: true, enum: [visa, mastercard, amex, unknown] }
            last4: { type: string, readOnly: true, pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$' }
    SepaDebitPaymentMethod:
      type: object
      required: [type, sepa_debit]
      properties:
        type: { const: sepa_debit }
        sepa_debit:
          type: object
          properties:
            iban: { type: string, writeOnly: true }
            mandate_reference:
    Error:
      type: object
      required: [error]
      properties:
        error:
          type: object
          required: [code, message]
          properties:
            code:
              type: string
              enum:
                - card_declined
                - expired_card
                - invoice_not_editable
                - idempotency_key_in_use
                - resource_missing
            message: { type: string }
            doc_url: { type: string, format: uri }
...
